decisions.statement: The feed sends a list of stoplights and only the first is drawn.
Whether a level past either end of its scale draws its number is read off the reading sent.
A reading saying nothing of that has the level past either end draw no number.
Nothing here works out whether a level past either end draws its number.
A level with no tier above that level draws no arc.
The arc says how far the next tier is.
The stoplight every ring is handed carries the moment taken and the fall rate.
A stoplight sent without either is decoded rather than refused.
A stoplight asked for its figure at a moment subtracts the clock in one place.

definition: the tile drawing where a safety level stands
